title: rust-mutants reached v1
description: The measurement a coverage run kept: which blocks each target's own run covered, which blocks the coverage build instrumented at all, and what the measurement could not establish. A place outside `instrumented` is a place nothing may be concluded about.

targets.description: Every target that ran, by identity, with the blocks its run covered. Empty when nothing was measured.

instrumented.description: Every block the coverage build instrumented, whether or not it ran.

limitations.description: Why the measurement is not what it could be, in the order it was found out.

block.description: One stretch of source a test really ran.

point.description: A 1-based line and a 1-based byte column, the unit llvm-cov reports regions in.
